descriptionByLocale.en:
Located in Château-d-Oex, 1000 metres above sea level, the Health Centre of the Country-d-Enhaut offers a wide range of hospital services, accommodation, accompaniment for the elderly, and home care. According to the so-called integrated care approach, this innovative organization represents an opportunity for health professionals to work in small multidisciplinary teams, for better continuity of care and in response to the health needs of the population of the Upper Country.
In the heart of a privileged natural environment, less than an hour away from Lausanne or Bern, the Pays-d'Enhaut is renowned for its quality of life and offers a wide range of sports, leisure and cultural activities, to live summer and winter!
For its Human Resources sector, the Country Health Department is looking for a:

HR Specialist - Payroll (CDI - 60%)

Your mission:

• Ensure the monthly salary and its variable portion (indemnities, overtime, allowance, etc.);

• Managing tax-related approaches at source;

• Prepare various documents for employees and authorities (e.g. salary receipts, salary certificates);

• Carry out the necessary administrative procedures with social insurance , authorities and external partners in relation to pay.
Other responsibilities / versatility:

• Support HR services as required on various administrative tasks and processes: monitoring of personnel files, monitoring of medical certificates, management of illness and absences, preparation of documents, etc.
Your profile:

• SWC of trade employee or equivalent;

• Certificate of Personnel Management Assistant,

• At least 2 years of experience in a similar position, ideally in the health field;

• Good control of common computer tools; knowledge of Opale and PolyPoint (PEP) systems is an important advantage;

• Discretion and confidentiality;

• Excellent oral and written communication;

• versatility, flexibility, initiative and autonomy;

• Excellent sense of organization and rigour in the work;

• Good stress resistance and ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
We offer:

• A pleasant and stimulating working environment

• Self-reliance in tasks

• Opportunities for professional development and training

• Wage and social conditions in accordance with the CTC-San Vaud

• Location : Hospital Road 17, 1660 Château-d'Oex

• Type of contract: contract of indefinite duration

• Start date: 01.11.2026 or to be agreed.

• Verwaltung steuerlicher Ansätze an der Quelle;

• Bereiten Sie verschiedene Dokumente für Mitarbeiter und Behörden vor (z. B. Gehaltsbelege, Gehaltsbescheinigungen);

• Führen Sie die erforderlichen Verwaltungsverfahren mit der Sozialversicherung, Behörden und externen Partnern in Bezug auf die Bezahlung durch.
Sonstige Verantwortlichkeiten / Vielseitigkeit:

• Unterstützung von HR-Services bei Bedarf für verschiedene administrative Aufgaben und Prozesse: Überwachung von Personalakten, Überwachung von ärztlichen Zeugnissen, Management von Krankheit und Abwesenheiten, Erstellung von Dokumenten usw.
Ihr Profil:

• SWC des Handelsangestellten oder eines gleichwertigen Unternehmens;

• Bescheinigung des Personalmanagement-Assistenten,

• Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Position, idealerweise im Gesundheitsbereich;

• Gute Kontrolle der gängigen Computer-Tools; Kenntnisse der Opale und PolyPoint (PEP) Systeme ist ein wichtiger Vorteil;

• Diskretion und Vertraulichkeit;

• Ausgezeichnete mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikation;

• Vielseitigkeit, Flexibilität, Initiative und Autonomie;

• Ausgezeichneter Sinn für Organisation und Strenge in der Arbeit;

• Gute Stressresistenz und Fähigkeit, mehrere Aufgaben und Prioritäten gleichzeitig zu verwalten.
Wir bieten:

Located in Château-d-Oex, at an altitude of 1000 metres, the Country-d-Enhaut Health Centre offers a wide range of hospital services, accommodation, accompaniment for the elderly and home care. According to the so-called integrated care approach, this innovative organization represents an opportunity for health professionals to work in small multidisciplinary teams, for better continuity of care and in response to the health needs of the population of the Upper Country.
In the heart of a privileged natural environment, less than an hour away from Lausanne or Bern, the Pays-d'Enhaut is renowned for its quality of life and offers a wide range of sports, leisure and cultural activities, to live summer and winter!
